description: This file defines normalization functions for the PyTorch C++ API, including implementations for normalize, layer_norm, local_response_norm, and group_norm, with internal detail functions and documentation links.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Performs normalization on input tensor with options for p, dim, eps, and out.

methods.name: layer_norm
methods.description: Applies layer normalization to the input tensor with specified normalized shape and options.

methods.name: local_response_norm
methods.description: Applies local response normalization to the input tensor with specified parameters.

methods.name: group_norm
methods.description: Applies group normalization to the input tensor with specified number of groups and options.
